name: Warsong Runner Update
summary: At Zoram'gar Outpost, Warsong Runner Update carries word from western Ashenvale to Kadrak.

sections.title: Eyes on the Western Front
sections.body: At Zoram'gar Outpost, the Warsong runner watches the coast and nearby threats in western Ashenvale. Scouts gather observations there, and the dispatch records what they see. It travels to Kadrak's watchtower on the Barrens border. The report helps Horde leaders strengthen their position and plan movements into the elves' ancestral woods.

faq.q: What is the Warsong Runner Update?
faq.answer: Warsong Runner Update carries frontline observations from the Warsong runner at Zoram'gar Outpost to Horde leaders at the Barrens border.

faq.q: Where does this dispatch come from?
faq.answer: The dispatch comes from the Warsong runner at Zoram'gar Outpost, on Ashenvale's far western coast near the Zoram Strand.

aliases: who do i turn this in to
faq.answer: Kadrak, the Warsong commander in the watchtower along the northern Barrens border, receives the update.

faq.q: Why does Kadrak need this dispatch?
faq.answer: Kadrak coordinates the Warsong clan's military movements into Ashenvale. Dispatches from outposts such as Zoram'gar tell him about enemy resistance, naval approaches, and control of local territory.

angles.text: The report shows how difficult it is to maintain distant outposts in hostile night elf territory. Couriers keep communications open between Ashenvale and the Barrens.
As an orc, you know Warsong scouts and couriers risk their lives in dense forests to bring tactical reports to Kadrak and advance the clan's territorial claims.
